site.title: Alon Tools
site.description: Privacy-first developer tools running locally in your browser.
site.privacy: Everything runs locally in your browser. Files and text are not uploaded to any cloud.
base64.title: Base64 encoder & decoder
base64.description: Encode and decode Base64 locally in your browser. Your text never leaves your device.
json.title: JSON viewer & formatter
json.description: Validate, format and minify JSON locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.
urlEncoder.title: URL encoder & decoder
urlEncoder.description: Encode and decode URLs, query parameters and special characters locally in your browser.
jwt.title: JWT decoder
jwt.description: Decode JWT tokens locally in your browser. The signature is not verified and the token is never uploaded.
jwt.warning: The token is processed locally in your browser. The signature is not verified.
md5.title: MD5 generator
md5.description: Generate MD5 hashes from text locally in your browser.
diff.title: Diff checker
diff.description: Compare two texts and quickly find added, removed and unchanged lines.
markdown.title: Markdown writer & preview
markdown.description: Write Markdown and preview the rendered result in real time.
imageCompressor.title: Image compressor
imageCompressor.description: Compress images locally in your browser without uploading them to any server.
imageConverter.title: Image converter
imageConverter.description: Convert images between PNG, JPEG and WebP locally in your browser.
imageInfo.title: Image information and metadata
imageInfo.description: View image size, format, dimensions and useful metadata locally.
photoCensor.title: Photo censor
photoCensor.description: Censor sensitive parts of images locally with pixelation, blur or black boxes.
favicon.title: Favicon generator
favicon.description: Generate favicons from text, colors or images locally in your browser.
geocoder.title: Address coordinates
geocoder.description: Find GPS coordinates by searching an address or selecting a point on a map.
ipInfo.title: IP information
ipInfo.description: Look up technical and geographic information for an IP address using ip.guide.
socialPreview.title: Social URL preview
socialPreview.description: Preview how a URL may look on Twitter/X, Facebook and WhatsApp using Open Graph and Twitter Cards.
curl.title: cURL builder
curl.description: Configure HTTP requests and generate code for terminal cURL, PHP, JavaScript and Python.
urlInspector.title: URL inspector
urlInspector.description: Analyze a URL and inspect protocol, domain, path, query string and developer examples.
